title: FaebrightWho
description: ver wanted to see who was actually online not counting clankers? Simply drop in FaebrightWho to your addon folder and it will take over the /who command and have a minimap button. You can have it do a full scan to find all players and specify by excluding certain guilds, levels, classes, races (looking at you gnomes) and display all information on the page!
author: Calisson
